property_summary: For any caller with admin rights (the deployer) and any proposed owner other than the admin, setOwner must leave owner() equal to the proposed address; the mutant overwrites owner to admin after the call, breaking this for any input with _owner != admin.
change_summary: Insert `owner = admin;` after the `_` placeholder in the onlyAdmin modifier so owner is overwritten to admin after setOwner completes.
